title: Pan-Seared Crispy Noodles
description: A Japanese-inspired dish featuring crispy pan-seared noodles, served with a side of steamed rice.
instructions: Heat 1 tbsp of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the flat rice noodles and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until slightly browned.
Add the zesty seasoning blend and stir-fry for an additional minute.
Add the fresh noodles and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
Serve hot with a side of steamed rice.
